:::{#exm-symmetric-relation}
#### Symmetric and non-symmetric relations on the real numbers

On $\reals$, the [relation](functions.qmd#def-relation) $=$ is [symmetric](#def-symmetric-relation):
whenever $a = b$, also $b = a$.
The relation $\le$ is not symmetric, since $2 \le 5$ is true but $5 \le 2$ is false.

:::
